message.easy-freecam.config_save_failed: Could not save Easy Freecam settings. See the log for details.
tooltip.easy-freecam.horizontal_speed: How fast the freecam moves sideways and forward.
tooltip.easy-freecam.vertical_speed: How fast the freecam moves up and down.
tooltip.easy-freecam.sprint_multiplier: How much faster sprint mode moves the freecam.
tooltip.easy-freecam.smooth_camera_movem: Smoothly accelerate and decelerate the freecam like spectator movement.
tooltip.easy-freecam.adjust_speed_with_m: Use the mouse wheel to temporarily adjust freecam speed without changing the configured base speeds.
tooltip.easy-freecam.show_hand: Render the held item and hand while freecam is active.
tooltip.easy-freecam.show_player: Render your real player model while freecam is active.
tooltip.easy-freecam.disable_on_damage: Automatically return to your player when you take damage, including absorbed damage.
tooltip.easy-freecam.allow_food: Allow the real player to eat food while freecam is active.
tooltip.easy-freecam.allow_drinks: Allow the real player to drink consumable items while freecam is active.
tooltip.easy-freecam.allow_elytra_rocket: Allow firework rockets while the real player is flying with an elytra.
tooltip.easy-freecam.allow_inventory_act: Allow dropping items with Q and swapping hands with F while freecam is active.
